description: This file contains unit tests for the class AbstractSnapshotTuner and its subclass SchemaOnlyTuner within the org.openmrs.liquibase package. The tests cover functionalities such as reading files, detecting license headers, adding license headers, and preventing security vulnerabilities like XXE attacks.

classes.name: AbstractSnapshotTunerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the behavior of AbstractSnapshotTuner and its subclass SchemaOnlyTuner, focusing on license header detection, file reading, and security against XXE attacks.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SchemaOnlyTuner instance before each test.

methods.name: shouldFindOpenMRSHeaderInFile
methods.description: Tests detection of the license header in a file.

methods.name: shouldDetectMissingOpenMRSHeaderInFile
methods.description: Tests that the absence of the license header is correctly detected.

methods.name: shouldReadFile
methods.description: Verifies that file content can be read and contains expected license link.

methods.name: shouldReadResource
methods.description: Verifies resource content reading includes the license link.

methods.name: shouldAddLicenseHeaderToXmlFile
methods.description: Tests adding a license header to a file lacking one.

methods.name: shouldCreateUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Tests that a file is correctly updated with the license header.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Helper method to read file contents from a path.
